dedupe_keys.name: kz cert computer incident statistics kazakhstan 2011 to 2026

description: KZ-CERT, the computer emergency response team run by Kazakhstan's State Technical Service, publishes statistics of the computer incidents reported to it. The statistics page read on 2026-09-28 lets users choose any year from 2011 to 2026 and show counts by half-year, quarter or month for seven incident classes: botnets, loss of access to information resources, computer viruses, worms and trojans, denial of service (DoS and DDoS) attacks, unauthorised access and modification of content, phishing and other incidents; the default view showed 43,255 virus and trojan incidents, 4,221 botnet incidents, 1,007 unauthorised access cases, 430 phishing cases, 358 other incidents, 9 losses of access and 4 denial of service attacks. Coverage is national, for incidents reported to KZ-CERT. Access is free in an interactive chart in Russian, Kazakh and English; no licence or download is offered. Caveats: counts reflect reports and detection, not all incidents; affected sectors are not given, and figures must be read off the chart. It supports cyber threat frequencies for resilience studies of Kazakh digital and critical infrastructure. No related Kazakh cyber record is catalogued; other national CERT statistics complement it.
